title: Salon advertising: fill your appointment book

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing makes Google Search available from $30/day for salon campaigns.
facts.quote: Google Search | Reaches people searching for a service near them, such as balayage near me | Filling open slots this week | $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing makes Facebook and Instagram available from $30/day for salon campaigns.
facts.quote: Facebook and Instagram | Shows before-and-after photos and short videos to nearby people by age and interest | New clients who choose a stylist by looking at their work | $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing makes YouTube and Google Demand Gen available from $30/day for salon campaigns.
facts.quote: YouTube and Google Demand Gen | Video and image ads across Google's network | Broad local reach with video | $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing makes Streaming TV available from $30/day for salon campaigns.
facts.quote: Streaming TV | Puts a 15- or 30-second spot on the living room screen in your area | Local familiarity, launches, new locations | $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing makes mobile web and app image ads available from $30/day for salon campaigns.
facts.quote: Mobile web and apps | Image ads on sites and apps people use every day | Repeat exposure at low cost | $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing makes Reddit ads available from about $35/day for salon campaigns.
facts.quote: Reddit | Ads in local and interest communities | Younger, research-minded clients | about $35/day

facts.fact: TikTok in Adwave is opt-in and starts from $91 per day once turned on in Customize and the TikTok account is connected.
facts.quote: starting from [$91 per day](https://adwave.com/pricing/) once you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account

facts.fact: The Local Gem says setting up and maintaining a Google Business Profile costs nothing.
facts.quote: points out that the profile costs nothing to set up or maintain

facts.fact: The Local Gem says salons that complete their Google Business Profile and keep posting and collecting reviews usually see better local visibility within 4 to 8 weeks.
facts.quote: salons that complete it and keep posting and collecting reviews usually see better local visibility within 4 to 8 weeks

facts.fact: Roz Hair's guide summarizes Google's local ranking as depending mainly on relevance, distance and prominence.
facts.quote: local results depend mainly on three things, relevance, distance and prominence

facts.fact: Under the 5 to 15% of revenue rule, a salon taking in $15,000 a month would spend $750 to $2,250 a month on marketing.
facts.quote: For a salon taking in $15,000 a month, the rule works out to $750 to $2,250 a month.

facts.fact: Boulevard lists monthly salon marketing ranges of $150 to $750 for a smaller operation, covering social media, email, print and paid ads.
facts.quote: list monthly marketing ranges of $150 to $750 for a smaller operation

facts.fact: Boulevard lists monthly salon marketing ranges of $500 to $1,500 for a larger operation, covering social media, email, print and paid ads.
facts.quote: and $500 to $1,500 for a larger one, covering social media, email, print and paid ads

facts.fact: A LocaliQ survey of more than 300 small business owners from February 2026 found 52% had a monthly marketing budget under $1,000, as cited by Zoca.
facts.quote: a LocaliQ survey of more than 300 small business owners from February 2026, in which 52% had a monthly marketing budget under $1,000
